result.title: LOCUS: Locate Once, Check Until Settled. Draft-and-Verify Visual Grounding with a Box Head and Coordinate-Token Verification
result.comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Project page: https://muhammad-talha-ad.github.io/LOCUS/ Code: https://github.com/muhammad-talha-ad/LOCUS Models: https://huggingface.co/MTalha2001/LOCUS-2B and https://huggingface.co/MTalha2001/LOCUS-0.8B
result.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) ground a referring expression in one of two ways. They decode the box as coordinate tokens, which is precise but takes one sequential step per token, or they regress it from a hidden state with a small head, which takes one step but loses accuracy at high IoU. The two fail differently: a head usually finds the right object but places its edges loosely, while coordinate tokens place edges precisely. We therefore use the regression head as a speculative drafter for the model's own coordinate tokens. Locus writes the head's box as coordinate tokens and checks them with the same backbone by Jacobi iteration over a shared image prefix. The fixed point is the model's greedy coordinate-token answer, reached in about 5.60 sequential passes on average instead of 18.46 decoding steps; head and verifier are one set of weights, trained jointly. On the 8 RefCOCO, RefCOCO+ and RefCOCOg splits, verification raises Locus-2B's Acc@0.9 from 54.87 for its own head to 59.13, and the one-pass head is ahead at Acc@0.5 of every published model with at most 3B parameters except Florence-2-L. Against Jag, the strongest open regression-head model, at its own size and training budget, Locus ties at Acc@0.5 and, with typical acceptance, gains +4.52 points at Acc@0.9, with paired significance tests. Exact answers come 1.5x faster than vLLM greedy-decoding the same coordinate tokens with the same weights; a pure regression head remains faster still.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 LOCUS，把回归框头当作草稿器，将其输出写成坐标 token，再由同一套权重、共享图像前缀的骨干网络通过 Jacobi 迭代验证，收敛到模型自身的贪心坐标 token 答案，从而兼顾高 IoU 精度与并行解码速度，并在 RefCOCO/+/g 上报告了精度与 1.5 倍加速结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文对「回归头定位正确但边界宽松」与「坐标 token 精确但逐 token 串行」两类失败模式及计算代价做了直接对比，其「草稿—迭代验证至不动点」流程可供核查 LVR 中并行状态更新、停止判据与精度—计算权衡的具体线索。
